number_of_starting_lives.name: Lives
number_of_starting_lives.description: Number of lives player starts with.

number_of_starting_shields.name: Shields to Start
number_of_starting_shields.description: Number of shields player starts with.

number_of_texure_updates_rate_per_second.name: Sprite Update Rate
number_of_texure_updates_rate_per_second.description: How many times sprites update per second.

revive_shield_movement_speed_in_pixels_p.name: Revive Shield Speed
revive_shield_movement_speed_in_pixels_p.description: The speed of the revive shield moving through the map. Number indicates pixels per second

should_skip_intro.name: Skip Intro
should_skip_intro.description: Determines whether a new game should skip the instructions stage.

should_start_with_shields_active.name: Start With Shields
should_start_with_shields_active.description: Determines whether a new game should start with shields activated.

should_projectiles_collide.name: Projectile Collision
should_projectiles_collide.description: When turned on, magic attack and fire attacks collide and destroy each other.

is_music_on.name: Music
is_music_on.description: Determines whether music will play during playthrough.

number_of_demon_columns.name: Demon Columns
number_of_demon_columns.description: The number of demon columns a round should have. A column contains 6 demons.

number_of_rows_before_speed_boost.name: Rows At Speed
number_of_rows_before_speed_boost.description: The number of rows the demons will travel before increasing their speed.

demon_base_points.name: Demon Points
demon_base_points.description: The base number of points a demon is worth. This number will be multiplied during the game.

scamp_score_multiplier.name: Front Row Multiplier
scamp_score_multiplier.description: This number is multiplied by Demon Points and the level to calculate the points for the demons in the first two rows.

fledgling_score_multiplier.name: Middle Row Multiplier
fledgling_score_multiplier.description: This number is multiplied by Demon Points and the level to calculate the points for the demons in the middle two rows.

skull_score_multiplier.name: Last Row Multiplier
skull_score_multiplier.description: This number is multiplied by Demon Points and the level to calculate the points for the demons in the last two rows.

eye_score_multipler.name: Special Demon Multiplier
eye_score_multipler.description: This number is multiplied by Demon Points and the level to calculate the points of the special demon.

demon_base_speed_in_pixels_per_second.name: Base Demon Speed
demon_base_speed_in_pixels_per_second.description: The starting speed at the beginning of the first level. The base speed that will be increased with each row and level.

demon_acceleration_in_pixels_per_second.name: Demon Row Acceleration
demon_acceleration_in_pixels_per_second.description: The speed increase of the demons after they have moved a certain number of rows, which is identified by 'Rows At Speed'. This is in pixels per second.

demon_level_acceleration_in_pixels_per_s.name: Level Acceleration
demon_level_acceleration_in_pixels_per_s.description: The number of pixels per second the demons at the beginning of each new level.

demon_attack_rate_in_milliseconds.name: Demon Attack Rate
demon_attack_rate_in_milliseconds.description: How many milliseconds a demon will wait before being allowed to attack. Demon may not decide to attack at this time.

demon_projectile_speed_in_pixels_per_sec.name: Fire Speed
demon_projectile_speed_in_pixels_per_sec.description: The speed at which the demons projectiles move, in pixels per second.

demon_attack_chance_percentage.name: Attack Chance
demon_attack_chance_percentage.description: The percentage dictating how likely a demon will be to attack after pausing for the previous attack, which is determined by 'Demon Attack Rate'

attack_texture_update_rate_per_second.name: Attack Animation Speed
attack_texture_update_rate_per_second.description: How many times the player sprite updates per second when casting attack magic.

casting_shield_texutre_update_rate_per_s.name: Shield Animation Speed
casting_shield_texutre_update_rate_per_s.description: How many times the player sprite updates per second when casting a shield.

mage_speed_in_pixels_per_second.name: Player Speed
mage_speed_in_pixels_per_second.description: How quickly the player can move left and right

mage_attack_rate_in_millisecond.name: Player Attack Rate
mage_attack_rate_in_millisecond.description: The number of attacks a player can get within a second.

mage_projectile_speed_in_pixels_per_seco.name: Magic Speed
mage_projectile_speed_in_pixels_per_seco.description: The speed at which the players projectiles move, in pixels per second.
